rules.statement: A deed of gift by Muslim parents to their minor children, reserving a life-interest and the right to mortgage or transfer the land, is invalid if there is no acceptance on behalf of the minor donees.
rules.supporting_quote: "Where Muslim parents conveyed to their minor child by a deed, styled a deed of settlement, a land reserving to themselves a life-interest and the right to mortgage or transfer the land, and there was no acceptance on behalf of the minor,- Held , that the deed was inoperative to pass title to the donee."
